thread:
oncall-bot: SEV2 incident created: paged-attn allocator fragmentation + CUDA OOMs in us-east-1. Incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1778889999 — runbook: /runbooks/paged-kv-frag

sara: seeing repeated CUDA OOMs on paged-attn allocator. rtx-node-12 crashed twice, last restart at 03:09 UTC. logs show `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` in allocator.cpp:
```
ERROR allocator: kv_paged::alloc failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress at 0x7f3a2b...
Stack: allocator.cc:412 alloc_page -> pager.cc:1280 schedule_compact
```

alex: looking at kv metrics — fragmentation ratio has been climbing for ~6 hours, eviction rate stuck near 0.03/s, compaction backlog > 200 jobs. This looks like slow leak not immediate spike.

mike: taking oncall. immediate mitigation plan: bump evict_threshold to 0.80, pause async compaction to reduce concurrent allocator churn, and drain the flapping node for a targeted restart. Will coordinate customer comms.

sara: customer impact: hosted generation routes (gen.prod.{small,medium}) showing ~8% 503s for requests >1024 tokens since 03:15 UTC. A few customers hit repeated failures. No data exfiltration.

customer-ops: acknowledged. I'll send advisory to affected tenants with timestamp and ETA for fixes. Using template: `KV paging incident — degraded throughput` and will cc account owners.

mike: applied temporary patch to cluster configs on the affected ASG:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap allocator-config -p '{"data":{"evict_threshold":"0.80","async_compaction":"false"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime -n inference --selector=asg=us-east-1-paged
```
Patch landed at 03:28 UTC. Monitoring rebuilds now.

alex: metrics: fragmentation ratio started trending down on 3 nodes, but rtx-node-12 still shows high resident + stuck page list. I'll cordon + drain then reprovision. If drain fails to free memory, we'll force-image replacement.

julia: prepared fallback routing rule: route 10% of traffic from affected tenants to `redwood-small` variant and increase per-request timeout to 90s. I'll flip the rule if we see further customer errors.

oncall-bot: Incident updated: mitigation steps applied by mike. Next steps: targeted drain + node reprovision, schedule defrag/compaction out-of-band during maintenance window, and run an allocator heap-scan. Linked runbook and pager logs in incident.

mike: leaving a short handoff to night oncall: if OOMs recur after reprovision, escalate to eng-runtime and open a CUDA driver ticket with cloud provider (include `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`). Otherwise monitor 1hr and clear incident. :thumbsup:
